remarks: Spotless Two-Family Home in the Heart of Springdale! Nestled on a quiet street, this meticulously maintained home offers convenience, comfort, and incredible potential. Just a short walk to shops, restaurants, and only two blocks from the train station, this property is perfect for investors or owner-occupants seeking rental income. Each of the two spacious units features:  2 Bedrooms, Living Room, and Dining Room - All with beautiful hardwood floors, updated Kitchen with pantry for extra storage, Full Bath, In-Unit Washer & Dryer and Three-Season Porch for added living space or storage. The finished third floor includes a bathroom (not currently connected), kitchen plumbing, and electric heat-offering an easy conversion to a third unit in the R75 zone. Additional highlights: Full walk-out basement with storage bins, Under-house two-car garage  Separate utilities for each unit. Showings start Saturday, Feb. 8th.
